$comment: The one house style for Google Docs (#2001). The single source of style values: the linter (style_lint.py) checks against it, and the normalize pass will write it. Sections tagged source=template are measured from the owner's hand-built template doc (docs/research/2026-09-28-gdocs-house-style-spec.md). Sections tagged source=carried come from earlier validated decisions (#1768, #1770) because the template has no such construct. Unset named-style properties inherit from NORMAL_TEXT, as they do in Docs.

lists.unordered_glyph_note: The Docs API cannot create a '-' list (docs/research/2026-09-13-gdocs-dash-bullets.md), so normalize cannot fix this. Reported, never blocking.

blank_paragraphs.note: The template has no blank separator paragraphs. Heading spaceAbove separates sections.

code.note: Courier New for typed code; Roboto Mono is what the Docs native code block uses (#1768).
